title: experiment.review_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs CriticAgent to review the frozen ExperimentPlan against the frozen VerifierSpec. CriticAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M8) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

method_ref.description: Optional confirmed Method ref, including frozen component acceptance contracts.

experiment_plan_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ExperimentPlan object.

verifier_spec_ref.description: Optional frozen VerifierSpec ref; null on the current post-baseline verifier route.

benchmark_spec_ref.description: Optional frozen BenchmarkSpec ref supplying the authoritative metric, comparison semantics and budget when no VerifierSpec was predeclared.

baseline_result_ref.description: Optional frozen BaselineResult used to review factual baseline assumptions in the plan.
